text: 据同花顺iFinD数据，沪深京三市成交额超2万亿元，较上日此时放量594亿元，预计全天成交金额约2.5万亿元。截至目前，沪市成交额9626亿元，深市成交额10223亿元，北证50成交额153亿元。
text_en: According to Tonghuashun iFinD data, Shanghai-Shenzhen-Beijing three-market turnover exceeded 2 trillion yuan, up 59.4 billion yuan from the same time yesterday, with full-day turnover estimated at about 2.5 trillion yuan. So far, Shanghai market turnover at 962.6 billion yuan, Shenzhen at 1,022.3 billion yuan, and BSE 50 at 15.3 billion yuan.
